page.layout: One page of text, one block. Heading "DEDICATORIA" at the top, then one paragraph of dedication in roman type with a line break, then the greeting and signature in italic and roman below. Catchword "In." at the lower right. No margin notes, no page number, no running head.

main_text.head: DEDICATORIA
main_text.p: ratorumq; P atronos munifi-centissimos, Dd.ac Dn. FRI-DERICUM IV. Comitem Pa-latinum Rheni & Elect. Se-ptemvirum &c. ac Dd. Dn. MAURITIUM Hassiae Land-grauium &c. Protectioni di-uinæ commendo. Dat. Bud. 1608. 7. Jan.

page.notes: The first line begins with a fragment ("ratorumq;"), the cut-off start of "Oratorum" or similar; kept as a fragment. "Hassiae" is read from a worn word and may be "Haffiae" in print; uncertain. "Elect." and "Jan." are read from clear abbreviations. The heading is set in small capitals. The catchword "In." is at the foot right. Stains and show-through from the reverse are ignored.
